author: Stuarts
body:
So basically my second map for the map making contest?:

Map name: Karnak
Builder: Stuarts
Gamemode: Destroy The Monument [2 monuments , 4 obsidian total]
Contributors: EncryptedShoesHD , Vior_

Teams: Cyan & Purple (42 players per team cap)

XML: in the works
Download: WIP

Images: https://imgur.com/a/7PHpt

and so yeah, ummm I know its a big map and all.....no need to point that out >.<
Still undone, I have things to change and work on , but this is roughly what the end result will look like so
I hope you guys are looking forward to having fun on this map :)
(if it gets accepted or anything obvisously)
